title: Quantifying gender imbalance in East Asian academia: Research career and citation practice
reasoning: The paper focuses on quantifying gender imbalance and bias in academic careers and citation practices, which are empirical observations of social disparities. It does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics in a philosophical or normative sense, nor does it contain a component of evaluating or benchmarking faith, spiritual traditions, theology, epistemology, or hermeneutics.
